Same latency (MLAT 4), bit-exact, 0 edges.

structural_change: KIND1 sreset s2 gate: TT -17.2 / -9.6 / -1.3 ps at u_e1m / u_ad / u_m2 stage 1 from the pin-register operands (operand mux + decode + partial-product rows in one LAT-4 stage). Successor: OT_QMUL4_INCUT = every LAT-4 multiplier cut at C1 (mux/decode/normalise | rows) with KCP 4 operand copies instead of C3; same latency, bit-exact (lane leaf bench + mutants), 0 edges. Regional synchronous reset successor: eight arithmetic roots + four insertion roots have ot_sync_rst_relay SYNC2 on command root/TREE1 per destination root (entirely synchronous including assertion; no async-clear cells); pin command and output roots have local relays, all arithmetic/insert consumers synchronous under OT_SU_SYNC_RST. Port reset drives only relay input cells; steady operation stage
